title: Telepathic friend meets an unvoiced telepath

tellings.quote: one of the my friends who's telepathic recently had a contact with an unvoiced person

plain: A writer named Whitley Strieber, who says he has met beings from elsewhere, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that a friend of his who is telepathic, able to share thoughts without speaking, recently had contact with an "unvoiced person". He gives this around 2024, and if true it would suggest there are beings among us who communicate by mind alone.
